title: Assembly of the normalized identity projection at each coefficient stage
statement: Fix a six-functor operation datum $S$ of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], a space $X$, and one of its four coefficient stages. Write $U=S.\mathrm{pull}(\operatorname{id}_X)$. There is a unique $e:U\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{id}$ such that $e_{UM}\circ\kappa_M=t_M$ for every $M$, where $\kappa$ is the supplied identity compositor and $t$ is transport along the identity composition equation. For every compactification $c$ of $\operatorname{id}_X$, let $\sigma_c$ be the supplied proper identification followed by the right-adjoint mate of $e$. Then the compact-support projection of [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates] satisfies $$(1_K\otimes e_L)\circ\sigma_{c,K\otimes UL}\circ\operatorname{PF}^c_{K,L}=\sigma_{c,K}\otimes1_L.$$ At finite coefficients $K$ is arbitrary bounded constructible and $L$ is bounded constructible finite-Tor, and $e_L$ is restricted through the full inclusion. At integral coefficients $K,L$ are bounded constructible and only $L$ belongs to the datum uniform finite-Tor domain. At rational and common coefficients both are arbitrary bounded constructible objects. Four proved Lean stage lemmas realize this statement, with no additional hole in their module.

proof.text: At finite coefficients, derive sfIntrinsicPullbackId, compose with mapDerivedCategoryIdIso, and cancel the fully faithful constructible inclusion along finitePullback. The resulting identity isomorphism makes the identity inverse image full and faithful. At the three higher stages use [lem-sf-projection-identity-pullback-units].

Transport the source of the identity compositor along id_comp. Cancel the fully faithful inverse-image functor from its inverse compositor to construct an isomorphism e with identity. Naturality at e_M identifies e_(UM) with U(e_M); the compositor inverse/hom equation proves normalization. For two normalized candidates cancel the invertible compositor, then use naturality at an invertible unit component and cancel its image under U. These are the proved generic helpers normalizedIdentityUnit, normalizedIdentityUnitTransport, identityUnit_unique and normalizedIdentityUnitProperty.

Use [lem-sf-projection-identity-proper-counit] for the direct-image identity projection. The proper-coincidence clauses of [lem-sf-projection-finite-stage-laws, lem-sf-projection-integral-stage-laws, lem-sf-projection-field-stage-laws] identify tensor(properIdentification) followed by the proper projection with the compact-support projection followed by properIdentification. Compose with the counit mate and tensor(e_L), substitute the proper identity equation, and combine the two tensor maps by functoriality. This gives the stated support equation for every compactification. The generic helper identityProjection_of_proper proves this composition calculation, and normalizedIdentityUnitProperty packages it with existence and uniqueness. The four stage lemmas have no sorry.

theorem projectionIdentity_finite (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) :
    (∀ X : SixFunctorSpace D,
      letI : IsProper (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).hom.left := by
        change IsProper (𝟙 X.obj.left)
        infer_instance
      ∃! e : S.finite.pull (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 (sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X),
        (∀ M : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X,
          (S.finite.pullComposition (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X)).hom.app M ≫
              e.hom.app ((S.finite.pull (𝟙 X)).obj M) =
            eqToHom (congrArg (fun f ↦ (S.finite.pull f).obj M)
              (Category.id_comp (𝟙 X)))) ∧
        ∀ (c : Compactification (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).hom.left) (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X)
          (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn X.obj.left),
          CompactSupportFiniteProjection.component S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations (𝟙 X) c K L ≫
            ((S.finite.properIdentification (𝟙 X) c ≪≫
              ((S.finite.pullDirectAdjunction (𝟙 X)).ofNatIsoLeft e).rightAdjointUniq
                Adjunction.id)).hom.app
              (((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.partialTensor S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations
          X).obj K).obj ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.torPull S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations
          (𝟙 X)).obj L)) ≫
            ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.partialTensor S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations X).obj
          K).map ((ObjectProperty.isoMk
              (finiteTorConstructible C.l E n hn X.obj.left)
              (X := (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.torPull
                S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations (𝟙 X)).obj L) (Y := L)
              ((intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible C.l E n hn X.obj.left).ι.mapIso
                (e.app ⟨L.obj, L.property.1⟩)))).hom =
          ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.partialTensor S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations X).map
            (((S.finite.properIdentification (𝟙 X) c ≪≫
              ((S.finite.pullDirectAdjunction (𝟙 X)).ofNatIsoLeft e).rightAdjointUniq
                Adjunction.id)).hom.app K)).app L)
